rca of the issue: Original bug (now fixed): React reserves the `ref` prop on function components and silently drops it (does NOT forward to the function as a regular prop) unless the function is wrapped in React.forwardRef. The parent CharacterBuilder was passing <BesmTemplatePicker ref={someRef}> expecting the child to receive it as props.ref, but the function component received props.ref=undefined, hit the early-return guard `if (templates.length === 0) return null`, and rendered nothing. The fix renames the prop to a non-reserved name (besmRef), which React passes through verbatim. Verified live: picker.is_visible()=True, counts text exact match, preview bundle renders, Apply button enabled — all symptoms of the silent-null bug are gone.
